edges.reason: mintSakeXOnWhitelistPhase transfers msg.value to treasury before nowTokenId and numberOfWhitelistClaimed are updated, so an external recipient can reenter before state effects are applied.
mintSakeXOnPublicSalePhase performs the ETH transfer to treasury before updating nowTokenId and numberOfPublicSaleClaimed, allowing reentrant calls to observe stale state.
msg.value is forwarded to the mutable treasury address, which may be a contract that reenters the minting functions.
msg.value is forwarded to the mutable treasury address in the public sale path, a reentrancy entry point.
msg.sender is hashed into the merkle leaf and used as the key for numberOfWhitelistClaimed accounting.
msg.sender drives the numberOfPublicSaleClaimed per-address cap.
The whitelist phase gate depends on block.timestamp compared with whitelistSaleStartTime, a miner-influenceable value.
The public sale gate depends on block.timestamp compared with publicSaleStartTime, a miner-influenceable value.
setStartingIndex uses blockhash(block.number - 1) as its randomness source, which is block-producer influenced and not secure randomness.
setStartingIndex writes the derived value into the startingIndex state variable.
nowTokenId is added to numberOfTokens for token id derivation and then incremented, an arithmetic-sensitive supply counter.
nowTokenId is added to numberOfTokens for token id derivation and then incremented in the public mint path.
numberOfWhitelistClaimed is incremented by the caller-supplied numberOfTokens and compared against the cap.
numberOfPublicSaleClaimed is incremented by the caller-supplied numberOfTokens and compared against the cap.
merkleRoot is consumed by MerkleProof.verify during the whitelist mint.
isWhitelisted verifies the proof against the current merkleRoot.
setMerkleRoot is owner-only and rewrites the whitelist root controlling who may mint.
_safeMint calls onERC721Received on contract recipients, giving the recipient control flow during the whitelist mint loop.
_safeMint triggers the onERC721Received callback during the public sale mint loop.
reserveWhitelistSakeX uses _safeMint, invoking the receiver callback on contract recipients.
reservePublicSaleSakeX uses _safeMint, invoking the receiver callback on contract recipients.
reserveWhitelistSakeX computes token ids from nowTokenId and increments it by numberOfTokens.
reservePublicSaleSakeX computes token ids from nowTokenId and increments it by numberOfTokens.
reserveWhitelistSakeX bounds the mint by the whitelistSupply cap.
reservePublicSaleSakeX bounds the mint by the combined whitelist and public sale supply.
burn authorizes the caller via _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId).
tokenURI branches on the startingIndex state variable to shuffle revealed ids.
tokenURI only returns revealed URIs when _blindBoxOpened is true.
tokenURI computes tokenId + startingIndex and conditionally subtracts MAX_SakeXSupply for wrap-around.
flipBlindState toggles the _blindBoxOpened reveal flag.
flipWhitelistSaleState toggles the whitelistSaleIsActive gate.
flipPublicSaleState toggles the publicSaleIsActive gate.
setWhitelistSaleStartTime is owner-only and mutates the timestamp gate for whitelist minting.
setPublicSaleStartTime is owner-only and mutates the timestamp gate for public minting.
setSakexURI is owner-only and rewrites the metadata base URI returned to users.
sakexURI returns the stored _sakexURI state variable.
tokenURI calls sakexURI to obtain the base string used in revealed URIs.
setStartingIndex is protected by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to the owner.
reserveWhitelistSakeX is protected by onlyOwner, restricting reserve minting to the owner.
reservePublicSaleSakeX is protected by onlyOwner, restricting reserve minting to the owner.
setWhitelistSaleStartTime is onlyOwner protected.
setPublicSaleStartTime is onlyOwner protected.
setMerkleRoot is onlyOwner protected.
setSakexURI is onlyOwner protected.
flipWhitelistSaleState is onlyOwner protected.
flipPublicSaleState is onlyOwner protected.
flipBlindState is onlyOwner protected.

normalization_plan.reason: Proof parameter is consumed only by the isWhitelisted merkle verification, so it is normalized into that function.
Proof parameter flows directly into the whitelist mint verification, so it collapses into the mint function.
Quantity parameter drives the whitelist mint caps, token id computation and claim accounting of that function.
Quantity parameter drives the public mint caps, token id computation and claim accounting of that function.
Quantity parameter controls the whitelist reserve loop and nowTokenId increment.
Quantity parameter controls the public reserve loop and nowTokenId increment.
Timestamp parameter is written to whitelistSaleStartTime by this owner-only setter.
Timestamp parameter is written to publicSaleStartTime by this owner-only setter.
Root parameter is assigned directly to the merkleRoot state variable.
URI parameter is assigned directly to the _sakexURI state variable.
Token id parameter is only used for existence and shuffle computation inside tokenURI.
Token id parameter is only used for the ownership check and burn inside burn().
Cached counter is a temporary read of nowTokenId used only inside the whitelist mint.
Cached counter is a temporary read of nowTokenId used only inside the public mint.
Leaf hash of msg.sender is a transient value used only within the whitelist verification.
Loop counter is a transient batching variable scoped to the mint loops.
Shuffled id is a transient computation used only to build the returned URI in tokenURI.
Cached base URI is a transient read of _sakexURI used only inside tokenURI.
Hardcoded blind box string is a transient local used only as the pre-reveal return value.
